name: How long does door opening framing usually take?
description: Simple framing can be quick, but structural openings take longer because the wall support and permit steps add time.

mainEntity.name: How long does door opening framing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on whether the work is simple trim framing or a structural opening that needs a header rebuild and permit coordination. A straightforward interior opening may move quickly, while a load-bearing modification or permit-based job usually takes longer because of inspection and construction steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple framing can be quick, but structural openings take longer because the wall support and permit steps add time.
